$comment: World-state fixture (#198). NOT CONTENT: it lives outside content/ so neither the loader nor content:validate ever sees it, and nothing ships it. Its chapter ids are placeholders with no files behind them. It exists to show world facts once each - an enum locale, an enum threat, a counter alliance, a hidden route flag and a visible consequence - written by node completion rules and an edge effect, read by edge guards and by node variants, and the mill village's four faces on revisit: standing (first visit), market day (a later visit while it stands), displaced (after the wyrm wakes), restored (walked through, never replayed). world-state.test.ts holds it to the parser, the runtime and the lint, packages/server/src/handlers/world-state.test.ts plays it through the server, and tools/content/campaign-graph-schema.test.mjs holds it to the schema;docs/campaigns/graph-campaigns.md (World state) walks through it.
title: The Ash Wyrm Sampler
blurb: A crossroads, a mill village and a sleeping wyrm. Wake it, and the village is not where you left it.

mill-village.$comment: A locale with three states. Which one it is chooses the village's chapter on every entry.
mill-village.label: The mill village

river-folk.$comment: An alliance as a bounded counter: favours owed, nought to three. A fourth favour still reads three.
river-folk.label: Favours of the river folk

ford-path.$comment: A route the party finds by sneaking past the sleeping wyrm. Not visible: the way across the ford is a surprise until it opens.
ford-path.label: The path to the ford

scorched-orchard.$comment: A consequence nothing reads: the world remembers it and the players see it.
scorched-orchard.label: The orchard burned

crossroads.$comment: The hub. Played once; every return walks straight through to the exit choice.
crossroads.title: The Crossroads

village.$comment: The revisit node. First match wins: restored (and then walked through, never replayed), displaced, a market day on any later visit while it stands, else the first visit's chapter.
village.title: The Mill Village

onComplete.$comment: A chapter reaches the world through a journey flag: it sets befriended_river_folk, the graph turns that into a favour and clears the flag for next time.
Falling short at the sleeping wyrm wakes it: the village is displaced and the orchard burns.
Every rule reads the same journey, so this one still sees the wyrm raging after the rule above clears it.
